events.title: Santas Wanted! We’re Joining Steam Next Fest This October!
events.summary: How many gifts can you make with these mischievous gnomes?Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory is joining Steam Next Fest this October!Step into Santa’s boots and run a chaotic gift factory in the demo!🎁 A pile of letters to tackle, a factory to keep running! Pick letters from the pile, make the gifts, and wrap them up! Upgrade your equipment and find your own way to run the factory.💤 They only work together when it’s time to slack off. Can you make them a real team? Bring those work-shy gnome

events.title: The Gnomes Are Clocking In — Demo Coming This September!
events.summary: The Demo Is Coming to Steam This September!Hello, we’re Tiny Workers!We’re excited to share that the Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory demo is planned to launch on Steam this September!Since our July playtest, we’ve been busy polishing up the Christmas factory as we work toward releasing the demo this September. A huge thank you to everyone who joined us for the playtest! Today, we’d like to give you a little preview of what you can expect on your next shift.Gnomes Learning on the JobGnomes

events.title: Steam Playtest is Live Now! : 06.27~06.30(PDT)
events.summary: Hello everyone!The Steam Playtest for Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory is now live.This is a chaotic Christmas factory management game where lazy gnomes keep slacking off. Your job is to catch them, throw them back to work, and keep the gift production line running.Playtest Period June 27–30 PDTIn this Playtest, you can:Catch lazy gnomes before they waste too much timeThrow gnomes where they are neededProduce and package Christmas giftsUpgrade your factory workflowTest improved animations

events.title: Public Playtest Now Open!
events.summary: Hello, Santa!Welcome to the Christmas gift factory.This is the first public playtest for Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory.The playtest is scheduled to run until May 4, 2026, at 11:59 PM PDT.Please note that the factory is currently in a trial run, so you may encounter bugs, inconveniences, or unexpected issues during play.Also, future updates may change, improve, or add new factory visuals, systems, and content.If you run into any issues or have any thoughts while playing, please feel free
